name: AI Agent Modes
description: Adds a Mode selector that scopes an AI agent to a curated subset of its sub-agents by prepending a scoped system-prompt directive (and optionally withholding the unnamed sub-agent tools).

suggests.ai:ai_assistant_api: Integrates modes with the AI Assistant API chat and its per-assistant overrides.
suggests.ai:ai_chatbot: Adds the mode dropdown (and optional speech) to the AI Chatbot (DeepChat) panel.
suggests.canvas:canvas_ai: Adds the mode dropdown to the Drupal Canvas AI page-builder panel.

project_description: AI Agent Modes puts a simple Mode dropdown in front of your AI assistant, so you can tell it what kind of job you want done before you start typing. Pick a mode such as "Page Builder Only" and the assistant is steered toward the sub-agents that build pages; leave it on "All, let the assistant decide" and it behaves exactly as it does today. A mode is a config entity naming a parent agent, a curated set of that agent's sub-agents, and an optional scoped directive that is prepended to the system prompt so the orchestrator routes work to the right sub-agent. By default a mode only steers (guide strength); a mode set to restrict strength additionally withholds the sub-agent tools it does not name from the request, and a site-wide Enforce tool scope switch can turn all withholding back into steering without editing any mode. The choice is remembered per user in Drupal's private tempstore. The dropdown appears in the Drupal Canvas AI panel and the AI Chatbot panel, and the "AI Agent Mode selector" block can be placed beside any other AI chat. The module also exposes the browser's own Web Speech dictation (microphone) and read-aloud in the DeepChat panel, both off by default and using no external service or key.
